ModMetaData.description:
Original mod by Yamazaki and OfGreyHairWaifu https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2941194426 If the original author requests it, I will remove this update.

Original mod notes (1.4):
Art by lovely Yamazaki.
Large toads fit to trample your enemies under their muscular hind legs. A sidegrade to bears in terms of raw DPS, but as fast as horses. Now with an event and a horribly destructive King Toad. Beware the red devil, or you will all end up deep in his belly. With Giddy Up they get faster and have more armour. Absolutely not balanced for vanilla.
